detail.title: GW170 Competition Racing Wheel with Pedals - Universal
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GW170 is a competition-style racing wheel with a 10-inch diameter and bimaterial covering, striking a balance between good looks and a confident, secure grip through every turn. It offers three customizable sensitivity levels — Arcade, Pro and Expert — so you can dial in responsiveness to suit casual arcade racing or more nuanced simulation play, alongside on-wheel customizable buttons for quick access to key functions during a race. Built-in dual-motor vibration adds realistic feedback synced to in-game events, while the ergonomically located pedal shifters round out a genuinely immersive setup. Universal compatibility across PC, PS3, PS4, Xbox One, Xbox Series S|X, Nintendo Switch and Android TV makes it a flexible choice for almost any racing rig.
